assessments.rationale: Choosing aluminum completely avoids the release of microplastics and nanoplastics during the cutting, molding, and finishing stages of manufacturing (Page 80, parameter (p)). It also prevents the generation of plastic waste during the production process (Page 80, parameter (r)), aligning with the Union's waste prevention goals (Page 7).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Use Phase and Distribution Phase, because aluminum is heavier, which conflicts with lightweight design (Page 80, parameter (t)) and increases transportation-related carbon footprint.
espr_parameters: (p) microplastic and nanoplastic released in production
(r) amounts of waste generated in production

assessments.rationale: Mechanical fasteners do not require chemical adhesives, thereby avoiding emissions of volatile organic compounds (VOCs) to air, water, or soil during the assembly process (Page 80, parameter (q)). It also eliminates the generation of hazardous chemical waste associated with adhesive application and cleanup (Page 80, parameter (r)), supporting the zero-pollution ambition (Page 3).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing Cost/Speed and Lightweight design (Page 80, parameter (t)) as fasteners add weight and assembly complexity compared to ultrasonic welding.
espr_parameters: (q) emissions to air, water and soil released in production
(r) amounts of waste generated in production

options_evaluated: Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with rare-earth magnets
assessments.rationale: Magnet-free synchronous reluctance motors avoid the high environmental footprint of mining and processing rare-earth elements (Page 33, parameter (m); Page 80, parameter (o)). This significantly reduces energy and resource consumption in production (Page 33, parameter (g)) and avoids toxic emissions to air, water, and soil from chemical extraction processes (Page 3, Page 80, parameter (q)).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Use Phase energy efficiency, as magnet-free motors may have slightly lower efficiency or torque density, potentially increasing use-phase energy consumption (Page 3, Page 33).
espr_parameters: (g) use or consumption of energy, water and other resources in production
(m) environmental footprint produced by manufacturing the product
(q) emissions to air, water and soil released in production

assessments.rationale: Passive heat sinks avoid the manufacturing of complex chemical phase-change materials, preventing the release of substances of concern and emissions to air, water, or soil in production (Page 9, Page 80, parameter (q)). They also avoid the plastic waste and microplastics generated when manufacturing active fan components (Page 80, parameters (p) and (r)).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Use Phase and Design because passive heat sinks add weight, conflicting with lightweight design (Page 80, parameter (t)), and may offer less dynamic cooling than active systems.
espr_parameters: (p) microplastic and nanoplastic released in production
(q) emissions to air, water and soil released in production
(r) amounts of waste generated in production

assessments.rationale: A monolithic design minimizes the total number of parts, which drastically reduces the consumption of energy, water, and raw materials during the manufacturing process (Page 33, parameter (g)). It also minimizes the generation of manufacturing waste and scrap (Page 80, parameter (r)) and lowers the overall manufacturing environmental footprint (Page 33, parameter (m)).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Repairability and Maintenance (Page 33, parameters (e), (f)) and End-of-Life (Page 33, parameter (m)), as monolithic structures are extremely difficult to disassemble, repair, or recycle.

assessments.rationale: Corded AC power eliminates the battery manufacturing stage entirely. Battery production is highly resource-intensive, requiring massive consumption of energy and water (Page 33, parameter (g)), generating hazardous chemical waste (Page 80, parameter (r)), and releasing substantial emissions to air, water, and soil (Page 3, Page 80, parameter (q)).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: User Convenience and Use Phase mobility, as corded vacuums are restricted by cord length and mains outlet availability.
